name: f16-after-resolve-content
caption: Tree view AFTER R (2nd attempt) -- SCREEN CONTENT UNCHANGED from step-02 (same sha256, confirmed via duplicate_of). This is BY DESIGN, not a defect: the DIFF panel renders `git diff HEAD` inside the selected worktree's own directory (unrelated to the main repo's conflict), and the 'conflict: app.py' banner persists because resolveConflictsWithAI() deliberately does not `git add` the resolved file (human-review safety contract), so the index still carries unresolved stage entries regardless of content. The actual resolution is real and evidenced on disk: see text-artifacts/03-git-status-after-R.txt (still UU, not auto-committed) and text-artifacts/04-app.py-after-R-markers-absent.txt (markers genuinely gone).
